detector.match_rule: same Keyword, Detection center within tolerance of the reference center, one-to-one

false_alarms.definition: Unmatched Detections centered inside annotated Unknown or Silence spans, divided by the total duration of those spans. Unlabeled gaps are not negative exposure.

target.note: Preliminary hypothesis target; unmet targets are reported, never redefined.

error_review.method: Automatic categorization against automatic AMI references. Clips are listening aids; no human listening verdicts are recorded here.

limitations: Reference word timings are AMI forced alignment, not manually verified.
Silence spans are inferred from annotation gaps plus low RMS.
Keyword counts per split are small; per-Keyword metrics are not reliable.
Detection spans come from 1 s windows and only approximate word boundaries.
